description: This file defines the BasketQueryService class which implements IBasketQueryService, providing functionality to query basket data from the database, specifically counting total items in a user's basket.

classes.name: BasketQueryService
classes.description: Provides implementation for querying basket-related data from the database, with a method to count total basket items for a specific user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total number of items in the basket for a given user by summing the quantities of all items in that user's baskets.
